protocol.boundary: per-pair BIC plateau evidence at hold 10 and hold 30 after five bisections
protocol.effect_curve: common-zero full H=8 + hold separation in internally normalised anonymous pose/velocity families
protocol.passive_null: smooth nonlinear response to cumulative refined action separation, with passive static and decaying components
protocol.commitment: one searched, description-length-penalized persistent event during H=8 or the first five held steps
protocol.decision: the same >=2/3 pairs pass boundary, commitment and persistence
protocol.task_information: none in alarm; Jenga classes are grading only
